urls.rationale: PRA §91000 criminal penalties — applies Act-wide including Ch. 6 lobbying violations.
PRA §91000.5 misdemeanor / civil penalties — applies to Ch. 6 lobbyist non-compliance.
PRA §91001 enforcement responsibility — designates FPPC enforcement covering lobbying.
PRA §91001.5 — enforcement supplementary provisions covering Ch. 6.
PRA §91002 — disqualification/forfeiture provisions applicable to lobbying violations.
PRA §91003 — injunctive relief / civil enforcement covering lobbying violations.
PRA §91004 — civil actions for unlawful payments, applies to Ch. 6 lobbying expenditures.
PRA §91005 — liability for amounts unlawfully received/expended, covers lobbying.
PRA §91005.5 — administrative penalties covering Ch. 6 reporting failures.
PRA §91006 — joint and several liability, covers lobbying.
PRA §91007 — citizen civil-action provisions covering lobbying violations.
PRA §91008 — costs and attorney fees in enforcement actions.
PRA §91012 — discretionary attorney fees provision covering enforcement.
PRA §91013 — late-filing penalty applying to Ch. 6 lobbyist reports.

notes: Same 16-section enforcement selection as CA 2015 ground truth. Ch. 11 contains 23 sections total in 2025; selected the enforcement provisions PRA-wide that explicitly cover lobbying. Excluded: §91003.5 (campaign-finance-specific injunctive supplement), §91008.5 (campaign-finance-specific), §91009-91011 (campaign-finance-specific contribution provisions), §91013.7 (campaign-finance-specific) — all out-of-scope per lobbying-only rule.
